escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Build a valid-looking handoff certificate from a manually curated subset of issue paths instead of binding scope to the complete immutable work-item compare.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the old certified issue_changed_paths with the immutable work-item compare and then rebuild the certificate using every observed path.
literal_case.expected: The prior subset is rejected and the replacement certificate scope exactly equals the immutable compare.
literal_case.observed: On material head 356a9a71613fc3c1db28e3c226ae161ea48ddfb6, the immutable work-item compare contains 60 paths and the replacement certificate is built from that complete set; scope digest is 41105e13b83f0328a7e75719ac4e983f1aa1684621978217a6eb8c3298a4e3cc.
literal_case.evidence: The exact 82b429068a98ac973afddbcbb4b06f5c97b065fa..356a9a71613fc3c1db28e3c226ae161ea48ddfb6 path inventory and the prepublication/terminal handoff validation for the regenerated certificate.

sibling_cases.evidence: The exact-scope validator receives paths added by the upstream develop synchronization, so omitting them causes a mismatch.
The exact-scope validator compares sorted sets and rejects a certificate when any observed compare path is omitted.

prevention_change.evidence: The replacement scope is sourced directly from the immutable connector compare rather than a curated implementation-only list.

detection_change.evidence: The certificate validation is invoked with --work-item-start-sha and one --issue-changed-path for every immutable compare path before publication.

literal_case.procedure: Run the professional patient workspace visual harness on the exact material head, use the real Visualizar avaliação button to open a historical version, and inspect runtime geometry plus screenshots.
literal_case.expected: The comparison-open state is rendered by Chromium; desktop is side-by-side, mobile is vertical, historical data is read-only, current data remains editable, close is visible and page-level horizontal overflow is absent.
literal_case.observed: On exact material head 356a9a71613fc3c1db28e3c226ae161ea48ddfb6, workflow #744 completed successfully and artifact 9912627687 contains comparison-open desktop/mobile captures with all runtime layout/read-only/editable/overflow assertions passing.
literal_case.evidence: evidence-issue1039.json and professional workspace visual artifact 9912627687.

sibling_cases.evidence: 1440x900 real-browser comparison-open scenario verifies selected history remains bound while displayed beside the current form.
390x1200 real-browser comparison-open scenario verifies vertical ordering/containment and no horizontal overflow.

prevention_change.evidence: The harness now has an explicit comparison-open scenario that clicks the real action and captures both target viewports.

detection_change.evidence: The gate now fails unless runtime DOM diagnostics prove the comparison-open layout, mutability boundaries, close action and overflow constraints.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Generate risk saturation from only a fixed canonical family list while the attack matrix or inherited controls retain an additional material family, allowing a producer-side ready state that a stricter consumer preflight rejects.

literal_case.procedure: Replay the consumer-equivalent delivery preflight against the published packet, then rebuild risk saturation from the union of matrix and active inherited-control families and replay the same gate.
literal_case.expected: The incomplete packet is rejected before publication; the corrected packet carries every material family explicitly and passes both producer and consumer preflight contracts.
literal_case.observed: The escaped packet was rejected specifically for an omitted extended family. On the current material candidate, the corrected saturation includes that family explicitly and the producer regression rejects the omission class before handoff.

sibling_cases.evidence: Generic producer regression omits a family declared by the attack matrix and proves the saturation validator rejects it.
The consumer preflight reproduced the escaped rejection while the strengthened producer validation now derives the same material-family union.

prevention_change.evidence: Producer validation now treats attack-matrix and active inherited-control families as material even when they are outside the canonical baseline.

detection_change.evidence: A consumer-equivalent preflight is replayed as the deterministic closure gate for this escape class.
